steps: Write the two parts of each outer side as 1x and 3x. The outer square has area 4²x² = 16x².
Each corner is a right triangle with perpendicular legs 1x and 3x, so its area is 3/2x².
Together the four corners have area 6x². Subtracting them leaves inner area 10x².
The given inner area therefore fixes x² = 160/10 = 16. No side length is needed.
The shaded frame has area 6 × 16 = 96 cm².
